entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Yazidids or Mazyadids or Shaybanids, were an Arab family that came to rule over the region of Shirvan in the mid 9th century. Starting from Haytham ibn Khalid's assumption of the ancient Iranian title of Shirvanshah in 861, they practically broke free of Abbasid control and was therefore out of scope for most chroniclers of the Caliphate.
